What this page is

Every morning (10:25) and evening (18:25) Claude scans LinkedIn and Indian business news for consumer brands that may need NorthSide, checks each one, and adds the good ones here. Nothing is ever sent to a lead automatically.

The lead types, in order of importance

  • 1 · Direct ask - a brand (founder, CXO or marketing head) posts on LinkedIn that it is looking for an agency or growth partner. Act on these first, within 24 hours.
  • 2 · Funding - a named brand just raised money (news). Fresh money usually goes into growth and marketplaces.
  • 3 · Hiring (company post / job listing) - the brand itself is hiring for e-commerce, quick commerce or performance roles. It shows they are investing in the channel.
  • 4 · Launch / expansion - new launch, new platform, new city or category.
  • 5 · Hiring (via recruiter) - a recruiter posts for a hidden brand. Low value: we cannot reach the brand. Kept on the Watchlist only.

Priority score (0-100)

Type (direct ask 40 · funding 30 · company hiring 22-25 · launch 18 · recruiter 5) + intent (High 25 · Medium 12) + freshness (up to 20, falls after 3, 7, 14 and 30 days) + founder/CXO found (10) + email/phone known (5). Watchlist leads are capped at 40. Work from the top.

Pipeline stages

New → Contacted → Replied → Meeting → Proposal sent → Won / Lost. Parked = deliberately on hold. Each lead has an owner (default Akash) and an optional follow-up date; due follow-ups appear first on Start here and in the evening email.

Intent

High = clear need and a named brand we can reach. Medium = good signal, softer need. Low = weak or unclear (Watchlist).

Your daily routine (10 minutes)

  • Open Start here for this week's numbers and the newest leads.
  • Look at the newest cards, Direct asks first. Each card tells you what happened, why it fits NorthSide and who to contact.
  • Use Copy message to copy the draft message, edit it, and send it yourself from LinkedIn or email.
  • Record what you did by replying to the evening Lead Radar email (or telling Claude), one line each: L0333: contacted · L0333: follow up 12.11 · L0333: owner Shikha · L0333: note asked for a deck. The next run (10:25 or 18:25) updates the page, so the whole team sees who was contacted, by whom, and what is next.

Copying and downloading

In All leads, filter what you need, tick rows and press Copy ticked rows, then paste into Excel or Google Sheets. Download CSV saves exactly what you see. The full Excel file (NorthSide_Lead_Master.xlsx) is refreshed every Sunday evening in the Linkedin folder.

Founders & decision makers

For every new Pipeline lead Claude looks up the founder or CXO on LinkedIn (public profile and recent posts only) and notes what they posted recently - a good opening line for your message. Emails and phone numbers are shown only when the person or company published them; they are never guessed.

Rules Claude follows

  • Outreach is done by the NorthSide team, never by Claude. Start with fresh leads (last 30 days).
  • Brands that are not a fit for NorthSide are left out quietly. Alcohol is excluded.
  • Agencies, job seekers, platforms' own jobs, restaurants, B2B and non-India roles are excluded.
  • Every lead links to the original post, job or article so you can check it yourself.
